description: Owner only: publish a finished errand call as a redacted transcript example (no audio, business shown as a category). Call once for a preview, show it, then confirm with its preview_hash.

business_category.description: What kind of business was called, shown instead of its name (default business)

call_id.description: The finished errand call to share

confirm.description: True only after the owner has seen the preview and asked to publish it. Without it nothing is published.

errand.description: The kind of errand, if one fits (optional)

outcome.description: What happened, in the owner’s words, 600 characters or fewer. Defaults to the call summary (optional)

preview_hash.description: The preview_hash from the preview the owner approved. Required with confirm.

title.description: Short title in the owner’s words, 120 characters or fewer. Personal details are removed (optional)

name: share_call_example
title: Share Call Example
